objectives: Build fluency with the mathematical language used in physics.
Choose suitable analytical methods for common physical problems.

outcomes.statement: Use vector calculus in Cartesian and curvilinear coordinates.
Solve ordinary differential equations arising in physics.
Apply matrices, eigenvalues and eigenvectors to coupled systems.

syllabus.title: Vector Analysis
syllabus.topics: Vector spaces, gradient, divergence, curl and integral theorems.

syllabus.title: Differential Equations
syllabus.topics: First- and second-order equations, series solutions and boundary-value problems.

syllabus.title: Linear Algebra
syllabus.topics: Matrices, determinants, eigenvalue problems and diagonalisation.
